title: boost-exception:x64-android build failure

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Host Environment**
- Arch Linux
- Compiler: Android NDK 21.0.6113669 (clang)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
- Create a triplet file with the below contents:

```
set(VCPKG_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE x64)
set(VCPKG_CRT_LINKAGE dynamic)
set(VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE static)
set(VCPKG_CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME Android)
```
- Then run: `./vcpkg --triplet x64-android install boost-exception`

**Failure logs** 

```
-- Building x64-android-dbg
CMake Error at scripts/cmake/vcpkg_execute_build_process.cmake:136 (message):
    Command failed: /home/HOUSE.GEEKCENTRAL.IO/geiseri/vcpkg/downloads/tools/cmake-3.14.0-linux/cmake-3.14.0-Linux-x86_64/bin/cmake --build . --config Debug --target install -- -v
    Working Directory: /home/HOUSE.GEEKCENTRAL.IO/geiseri/vcpkg/buildtrees/boost-exception/x64-android-dbg
    See logs for more information:
      /home/HOUSE.GEEKCENTRAL.IO/geiseri/vcpkg/buildtrees/boost-exception/install-x64-android-dbg-out.log

Call Stack (most recent call first):
  scripts/cmake/vcpkg_build_cmake.cmake:91 (vcpkg_execute_build_process)
  scripts/cmake/vcpkg_install_cmake.cmake:24 (vcpkg_build_cmake)
  installed/x64-android/share/boost-build/boost-modular-build.cmake:90 (vcpkg_install_cmake)
  ports/boost-exception/portfile.cmake:14 (boost_modular_build)
  scripts/ports.cmake:90 (include)
```
The associated error log below:
[error.log](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/files/4208988/error.log)

I think it might be confused as to the compiler I am using.  As if it wants clang, but its using gcc.
